page.overview:
Who is Martin?

A member of Clan DunBroch, he is, with Gordon, guard of the main entrance of Castle DunBroch. He is constantly found sleeping during his duty. In the introduction of the film, the triplets cut half of his mustache while he was asleep. He appears in a post-credits scene, where he is awakened by the witch's crow, who asks him to sign for a delivery of wood carvings, much to his amazement. Category:Brave Characters
